description: Stops an experiment with a reason, e.g. when life got in the way. Nothing is deleted: the schedule, the seed and the log stay in the file, and analyze_experiment still analyzes what was logged up to the stop date, flagged exploratory. A stop cannot be undone (annotated destructive), and a stopped experiment accepts no more day logs; it no longer blocks a new one on the same metric. An experiment past its last day cannot be stopped (analyze it). Stopping twice changes nothing. Local file only (experiments.json): never contacts Suunto, needs no credentials. Output: { id, stopped: { at, date, reason }, alreadyStopped, note }. Not read-only, destructive, idempotent.
name: stop_experiment
title: Stop an experiment (nothing is deleted, but it cannot be restarted)
